prose.name: Defense: Relay Alignment on <Planet>

beats.journal: The transmitter is fitted, but the dish has to align before it can lock on, and it is loud. I need to hold until it's done.

say: That's aligning now. Keep an eye out.

beats.journal: I fitted the transmitter at the <Place> and held off three waves of attackers while it aligned. The relay is live.
say: Link's up, and the signal's clean first time.
